settings.heading: Bathroom
settings.lead: From outdated or water-damaged to clean, modern and built to last. We handle the whole bathroom — demolition, rebuilding, tile, fixtures and finishing — so you deal with one contractor, not five.

settings.heading: A complete bathroom, start to finish
settings.text: Every bathroom is different, so we start with a free on-site visit to look at the space, talk about what you want and give you a clear written quote. Then our team takes care of every step until the room is ready to use.
settings.items:
Demolition & haul-away
Subfloor & wall repair
Tile floors, walls & wainscot
Shower & tub areas, glass panels
Toilet, vanity & fixture install
Drywall, paint, trim & lighting

settings.title: Full bathroom remodel
settings.text: Gutted down to the studs and rebuilt: new walls, porcelain tile floor and wainscot, glass shower panel, wall-hung toilet, recessed lighting, fresh trim and paint.

settings.title: Quality
settings.text: Professional-grade materials and proven methods on every job.

settings.title: Precision
settings.text: Straight lines, level surfaces and clean transitions — measured twice.

settings.title: Trust
settings.text: Licensed & insured, with honest written quotes and no surprises.

settings.heading: Get a quote for bathroom remodeling
settings.text: Tell us a little about the project and we'll get back to you with a free, no-obligation estimate — usually the same day.
